# VANTAIRE

> VANTAIRE is a fictional international designer footwear house specializing in architectural summer leather shoes — black openwork leather, woven lattice structures, breathable cut-outs, and low heels in a quiet-luxury register.

## Brand
- Signature: openwork / lattice leather, hand-woven feeling, breathable cut-outs, low heels.
- Positioning: between a sandal and a shoe — leather silhouettes for warm cities, long days, and quiet elegance.
- Tagline: "Leather, Cut With Air."

## The Lattice Collection (SS26)
- The Cage Flat — square-toe lattice flat
- The Split Slide — open slide with split band
- The Knot Mule — braided knot, low heel
- The Woven Loafer — basket-weave vamp
- The Ribbon Mary Jane — bow strap, block heel

## Site
- Single-page editorial homepage: hero, manifesto, collection grid, craft, lookbook, newsletter.
- Static, dependency-free (HTML + CSS + vanilla JS). Product imagery is crisp inline SVG.
